points.quote: We have elected to take a cautious but open position, so that students are free to use AI for ideation, drafts and modelling prototypes.
points.gist: The university takes a cautious but open position; students are free to use AI for ideation, drafts and modelling prototypes.

points.quote: Students can use generative AI as a tool for idea generation (ideation) and assisted creation of work when this is clearly credited and rationalised.
points.gist: Students can use generative AI for ideation and assisted creation of work when it is clearly credited and rationalised.

points.quote: Submitting work for assessment that consists only of substantially unmodified content from Generative Artificial Intelligence software will be considered as poor academic practice.
points.gist: Submitting work that consists only of substantially unmodified generative AI content is treated as poor academic practice.

points.quote: Persistent exhibition of poor academic practice through inappropriate use of Generative Artificial Intelligence tools, such as a lack of evidencing their use.
points.gist: Persistent poor academic practice through inappropriate AI use, such as not evidencing its use, is identified as inappropriate use.

points.quote: Detailed guidelines have recently been developed by our AI and Creative Practice Working Group and approved by our Learning & Teaching Committee (1 February 2024) to support acknowledging, citing and referencing the use of generative AI within work.
points.gist: Detailed guidelines on acknowledging, citing and referencing generative AI were developed by the AI and Creative Practice Working Group and approved on 1 February 2024.

points.quote: students should speak to their Course Leaders with any questions about the use of AI at Arts University Plymouth
points.gist: Students should speak to their Course Leaders with questions about AI use.

points.quote: The University will adapt teaching and assessment to incorporate the appropriate use of generative AI and support equal access.
points.gist: The University will adapt teaching and assessment to incorporate appropriate generative AI use and support equal access.

points.quote: In April 2026, Arts University Plymouth began a series of student sessions designed to hold an open conversation to help shape a student co-created set of statements about AI in creative education and practice.
points.gist: From April 2026 student sessions were begun to help shape student co-created statements about AI in creative education and practice.

points.quote: this webpage might not reflect the most recent changes in our approach to AI within the university.
points.gist: This webpage might not reflect the most recent changes in the university's approach to AI.

points.quote: The University will support students and staff to become AI-literate.
points.gist: The University will support students and staff to become AI-literate.
